evidence_records.locator: CMS Has Begun to Inform Supplemental Payers of Payment Suspensions, paragraph beginning According to CMS officials, when providers
evidence_records.claim: Suspended claims can be processed as approved while Medicare withholds payment.
evidence_records.inference_limit: Does not establish how each published PUF row handles suspension, refund or cash settlement.

evidence_records.claim: CMS supplied suspension reports in December 2025 and January 2026.
evidence_records.inference_limit: Historical failure does not prove a continuing October 2026 failure; reporting does not itself prove effectiveness.

evidence_records.locator: Same section, paragraph beginning In addition, based on our analysis
evidence_records.claim: GAO identifies at least $196,000 Medicaid cost-sharing paid during 2023–2024 suspensions.
evidence_records.inference_limit: Includes federal and state shares; not all federal loss, not a complete total.

evidence_records.claim: Final rule corrected prior recoupment wording because payments were stopped.
evidence_records.inference_limit: Specific correction does not imply all unrelated fraud cases had zero losses.

evidence_records.locator: PDF p.32 response to across all suppliers; final §425.670(c)–(e)
evidence_records.claim: Selected CY2023 ACO calculations exclude A4352/A4353 amounts across all suppliers.
evidence_records.inference_limit: Code-wide adjustment is not a supplier guilt list or a stated PUF deletion policy.

evidence_records.locator: PDF p.1 payment stops, revocations; p.2 beneficiary complaints
evidence_records.claim: CMS had already acted against fifteen suppliers in the historical catheter episode.
evidence_records.inference_limit: Detecting its known aggregate spike again is not original discovery.

evidence_records.claim: OIG describes incomplete ownership verification and unreported changes.
evidence_records.inference_limit: A missing public ownership record is not proof of a straw owner.

evidence_records.locator: Appendix A printed p.16; PDF p.18
evidence_records.claim: Gold Rush allegations cover $941 million received from Medicare and secondary payers.
evidence_records.inference_limit: The whole sum cannot be labelled federal loss or added to overlapping case totals.

money.basis: alleged receipts from Medicare plus secondary payers

evidence_records.locator: First two substantive paragraphs and Florida example
evidence_records.claim: Eleven suppliers are described without names; cited billing is in 2025–2026.
evidence_records.inference_limit: The 2024 supplier file cannot identify their later claims from geography/amount resemblance.

evidence_records.claim: CMS states the Preclusion List is not public.
evidence_records.inference_limit: Does not mean no public revocation dataset exists; LEIE, revocations and preclusion are distinct.

evidence_records.claim: The earlier catheter audit found both compliant and noncompliant sample items.
evidence_records.inference_limit: Improper payment and deficient documentation do not independently establish deceptive intent.

evidence_records.claim: Data cover final-action FFS DME-MAC line items; supplier and referrer files are separately aggregated.
evidence_records.inference_limit: No patient-level join, individual order/delivery proof, Medicare Advantage or secondary-payer cash trail.

evidence_records.claim: NPPES demographics are extracted at the end of the year after the reporting year.
evidence_records.inference_limit: Do not backdate current owners, contacts or addresses to each date of service.

evidence_records.claim: Methodology describes small-cell suppression with inconsistent claims/beneficiaries wording.
evidence_records.inference_limit: Absent row is not zero; use observed dictionary and nulls and preserve uncertainty.

evidence_records.locator: p.3 monetary variables and services count
evidence_records.claim: Monetary totals are reconstructed by multiplying the per-service average by services.
evidence_records.inference_limit: Do not multiply by claims; charge, allowed, payment and standardized amounts have different meanings.

evidence_records.claim: Public supplier/service schema has no owner, payment-suspension or cash-recovery field.
evidence_records.inference_limit: Ownership and disbursed unrecovered fraud loss require separate evidence.

evidence_records.claim: Independent recalculation confirms nine cohort results, six entry/matched/exit decompositions, two cross-code entry controls and nine national payment reconciliations.
evidence_records.inference_limit: Validates arithmetic over snapshots, not source truth, cash release, fraud intent or original discovery.

evidence_records.claim: Most 2023 A4353 cohort increase belongs to newly visible exact NPI/code/rental rows rather than growth of matched rows.
evidence_records.inference_limit: Newly visible row does not mean newly formed business, newly enrolled supplier or fraud; A4352 is also affected and not an unaffected control.

evidence_records.locator: Printed p.7 payment table (PDF p.9); printed p.6 methods and p.8 footnote32
evidence_records.claim: The $72,004,603 preclusion-vulnerability total includes $42,021,169 of pharmacy payments not prohibited by the described preclusion rules.
evidence_records.inference_limit: Do not label all $72 million established fraud or impermissible payments; this is a separate 2022–2024 cohort, not the eleven DME suppliers.

money.basis: plan Part C and Part D payments associated with revoked NPIs

evidence_records.claim: 44 of 83 NPIs newly visible for A4353 in 2023 already appeared in the prior A4351/A4352 cohort; 33 of 55 in 2024 did likewise.
evidence_records.inference_limit: Directly disproves equating new code rows with new businesses. Prior activity outside the three codes and suppressed activity remain unknown.

score_definition: Ordinal 1 weak to 5 strong research judgments; not fraud probabilities. Novelty is prospect of a new supportable fact, not claim of discovery.
publication_constraints: No inferred ownership from registered agents or addresses
No named novel suspicion from outliers
No conflation of charges, allowed amounts, claim payment measures, released cash, recoveries, prevented payments or federal share
No assertion current secondary-payer sharing failure without post-implementation evidence
